items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' in the final turn ('Monk, thank you...'), indicating the person named 'Monk' is the interviewer, not a third-party musician. No personal or professional relationship with a musician named Monk is described.

ctx.x: sax. And also unison string bass and left hand piano on occasion. Where do your compositions come from? Are you inspired by anything in particular?

Pretty much everything. I know that’s sort of a typical question, but that’s a hard question Monk, because I think like I mean I just feel like I’m influenced by so many things that I just hear, particular pieces like Pharoah Sanders and Leon Thomas, “The Creator Has a Master Plan.” I think of that, I think of Duke Ellington “Money Jungle.” I think of McCoy Tyner — what’s it called that tune? “Fly with the Wind.” I think of Don Pullen especially, you know his music, which had a huge effect on me. Carla Bley —…
Do you go to the piano first?
